turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hey, my card got hit with the same subscription fee two times this month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm so sorry, that's really annoying. Let me look into it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Both are $12.99 on the 2nd.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can see the duplicate. The refund is issued and you'll see it in 3 to 5 days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you tell me when my order is supposed to get here?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. Please share your order number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The estimated delivery is Thursday. You can track it under Orders, then Track.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The app keeps saying my password is wrong but I know it's right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please reset your password from the login screen.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I already tried that twice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please try again later.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is the third time I'm calling about an overcharge. I want a manager.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand, and I'm sorry it's taken this long.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Just get me someone who can fix it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've escalated this to a billing specialist who will call you back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The box arrived crushed and the blender inside is broken.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh no, I'm sorry it arrived like that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order 771032.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A replacement has shipped today at no cost, and you don't need to return the broken one.
